title: INC-6582: incident on the Reporting Mart
body:
IMPACT:

This report covers an incident on the Reporting Mart that is
resolved. Infrastructure linked roughly 38 tickets to the
event and engaged Corvid Analytics, the hosting provider,
within the first hour.

TIMELINE:

Rohan Mehta logged the following events, state as of 19
April 2025:
- Customers were notified through the public status page
- Failover to the standby database instance was started
- Error rates were compared against the weekly baseline

STATUS:

For tracking purposes the incident is resolved. Report
written by Hana Kowalski on 14 March 2025; the next review
falls in the 06:00-07:00 UTC window and goes to the weekly
service meeting.
